 Commands:
>  /help   Show help
  /plan  Plan mode
  /build  Build mode
  /verbose  Toggle verbose output
  /thinking  Toggle thinking display
  /theme  Switch theme
  /skill  Load a skill
  /diagnostics  LSP diagnostics
  /sandbox  Sandbox status
  /model  Switch model
  /fork  Create session branch
  /session  List/switch branch
  /exit  Exit TinyCode
